column1: # Oniscus install catalog, read by `onis install`.
#   category  method  target  command  needs  name  description (en)  description (pt-BR)
# method:  zypper  = package from the official Tumbleweed repositories (preferred)
#          flatpak = app id on Flathub, installed per user (no sudo)
#          npm     = npm package installed into ~/.local (official method of some AI agents)
#          script  = the project's official install script (target is the shell command)
# command: binary used to detect script/npm installs ("-" when not needed)
# needs:   commands that must exist first; onis installs them with zypper ("-" for none)
# Package names were written for Tumbleweed and must be checked with `zypper info`
# on the first real build. Prefer zypper; use Flathub only for apps not in the repos.
